name: Char
author: Erin Carter
description: A sheet of near-black paper consumed by a creeping ember edge: an irregular incandescent front eats across on a slow diagonal, graded hot-to-cool through the palette across its width, leaving darker char salted with brief cooling sparks. Staggered burn sheets crossfade while featureless, so the consumption never visibly resets.

params.label: Front speed
params.effect: How fast the burn front eats across the sheet.

params.label: Rim width
params.effect: Width in CSS pixels of the colour-graded incandescent rim.

params.label: Spark density
params.effect: Fraction of char-side cells that carry a brief cooling spark; zero removes sparks entirely.

params.label: Edge raggedness
params.effect: Scales the FBM perturbation of the front, from a nearly smooth contour to deep bays and racing fingers.
